sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
grid=[list(r) for r in a]
W=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if grid[r][c] in 'Ww']
# center = cell with 4 neighbors in W/w
center=None
for r,c in W:
    if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] in 'Ww' for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
        center=(r,c)
print("center", center)
# continue: down to row 48, then right to col 34
acts = ['DOWN']*(48-center[0]) + ['RIGHT']*(34-center[1])
print("remaining", len(acts))
res = action(acts[:8])
print({k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','game_over','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
